compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Paul calls for blameless witness and holds out the word of life, then describes being poured out on the sacrifice and service of the believers’ faith.
observations.label: Paul’s life is poured over their faith

observations.body: The passage presents public witness, word of life, labor, poured drink, faith’s service, and shared joy as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: public witness, word of life, labor, poured drink, faith’s service, and shared joy

observations.body: The passage places poured out service beside public witness, word of life, labor, poured drink, faith’s service, and shared joy.
observations.label: poured out service

payload.posture: Read Philippians 2:14–18 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: Paul’s possible death is pictured as a poured offering without making the believers’ faith an altar animal
